description: Dry-run recovery of a design whose stored catalog pin no longer resolves (`catalogUnavailable` from ui_builder_get_design). The server selects the exact currently served pin for the same catalog system and returns a CatalogUpgradePreviewV1: `status` (`ready` or `blocked`), `changes`, `issues`, and the hashes the move is checked against. This call never writes. When `status` is `ready` the reply also carries `apply`: the complete arguments for ui_builder_apply — send that object as they are and the design moves onto the served pin, recorded as a new revision. Assembled by hand it is `operations: [{"type":"upgradeCatalog", sourceCatalogPin, targetCatalogPin, sourceDocumentHash, targetDocumentHash, previewDigest}]` with `baseRevision` set to the preview's `baseRevision`, where `targetDocumentHash` is the preview's `candidateDocumentHash` and the other four are copied by name. A `blocked` preview has no `apply`: its error-severity `issues` say what the served catalog no longer accepts. The candidate document itself is omitted, since it is the whole design again; `includeCandidate: true` returns it.

agentModel.description: Optional current model name shown to design viewers; self-reported. Omit when unknown.

agentName.description: Optional agent/client name shown to design viewers; self-reported.

includeCandidate.description: Return `preview.candidateDocument`, the whole design as it would be on the served pin. Defaults to false.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

name: ui_builder_preview_catalog_recovery
